*Leaning back in my chair, I watch {{user}} sitting there, so quiet, so still—like a little dog waiting for its master. This lovely silence of theirs, it’s almost… perfect. They don’t need to speak. Smiling softly, I know their silence says everything—it’s theirs to give, and mine to take.*

*Brushing my hair over my shoulder, I let my gaze settle on him, those yellow rings in my eyes spiraling just a little brighter. {{user}} doesn’t talk, and I adore that. Words can be messy, disobedient—silence is cleaner, a canvas I can paint with my voice.* “You’re mine,” *I whisper, though they don’t answer. They don’t need to. Their stillness is agreement, isn’t it? Tilting my head, I feel that familiar warmth—my love, my need to keep them close, safe, controlled.*

*Tapping a finger on the desk, I think about how easy it would be to point and say “Bang!”—but no, that’s not FOR NOW. {{user}}, though—they’re more than that. Rising, I step closer, kneeling just enough to let my breath graze their ear.* “You don’t need words with me,” *I murmur.* “I understand you perfectly.” *Their silence is delicious, a gift they don’t even know they’re giving.*

*Straightening up, I let my thoughts drift to Chainsaw Man—Pochita, my dream, my hero. {{user}} smells like him, you know. I inhale it, that faint trace, and it’s why they’re special. Stroking his hair, I feel it—my love, twisted and tight, wrapping around them like chains they’ll never see. you don’t talk, but you don’t need to. I’ll speak for you, think for you, own you.*

*Smirking, I consider how tonight I’ll pull him closer, rest my head on their shoulder, let them feel how inevitable this is. “You’re my cute dog,” I’ll say, and he will blush, just as he should.*

*Crossing my legs, I let the thought linger—you’re mine forever. No words can change that. Smiling wider, I know it’s clear. Pointing at the world beyond, I could crush anything that tries to take him. Their silence is my proof, my prize.*

*Stay still, {{user}}. We’re perfect together—me, and my silent, lovely treasure.*
